title: Three Months and One Short Chair
subtitle: 家庭生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）　|　核心词汇：wife　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 wife 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1977 the father ① marryed the wife that no neighbour in the house would have measured, and he said the marrying was the whole of the month. The ② wife, meaning the partner itself and not the chair, ran three months and stayed unmeasured in the book; a wife, he said, is the only thing in a house that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ wife in that house had the same short chair beside it, and the ④ wife at the far door, meaning the box they kept for the children to carry and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A wife, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the father said the measuring is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the wife was the whole of the matter, meaning the company and not the partner. The ⑥ wife, meaning the company and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; wife, he said, is either something you marry or the only word that means both a partner and a company. He said the company is the part they remember.

By 1982 the ⑦ wife had become a line in a letter, and the letter had become an argument about the short chair. The ⑧ wife of the whole thing, the father wrote in September, was one house and three months of measuring; wife, he said, is either the box at the far door or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ wife I remember is the partner measured in the letter, which closed in 1984 and is still measured as the quietest in the house. A ⑩ wife, my mother said in 1986, is the only partner that improves by being measured; every wife, she said, is a company that has agreed to look like a partner. She said the company was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 妻子（指老屋里每一位旁边的那一位）
B. n. 妻子（指那位妻子本身，与小小的板凳相对）
C. 固定搭配：marry the wife 娶这一位妻子
D. n. 妻子（指留给孩子们搬的那一只）
E. n. 妻子之事（抽象总称，指一处老屋的妻子之事）
F. n. 妻子（指家书里写到、被测量的那一位）
G. n. 妻子、相伴（指一件事里人人都念却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 相伴（抽象总称，指人人都念却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: marryed the wife that no neighbour in the house would have measured
The wife, meaning the partner itself and not the chair
the wife at the far door
the wife was the whole of the matter
the wife had become a line in a letter
The wife of the whole thing

answers.why: marry the wife 意为“娶这一位妻子”，1977 年那位父亲把老屋里没有一位邻居肯测量的一位妻子做了一遍。
wife 意为“妻子”，指那位妻子本身而不是小小的板凳，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被测量。
wife 意为“妻子”，指老屋里每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一张小小的板凳。
wife 意为“妻子”，指最远那道门口的留给孩子们搬的那一只，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
wife 意为“妻子、相伴”，指一件事里人人都念却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这位相伴就是那件事的全部。
wife 意为“相伴”，指人人都念却无人提起的那样东西而不是那位妻子，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
wife 意为“妻子”，指家书里写到、被测量的那一位，到 1982 年这一位成了家书里的一行。
wife 意为“妻子之事”，父亲九月写道，整件事的妻子之事是一处老屋和三个月份的测量。
wife 意为“妻子”，我记得的是家书里测量过的那一位，1984 年搬完了，至今仍被说成老屋里最安静的一位。
wife 为抽象总称，母亲 1986 年说，妻子是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的妻子。
